stories.title: Rubio gelmeden Atina karıştı: Büyükelçilik önünde protesto

en.title: Athens in turmoil before Rubio's arrival: Protest in front of embassy
en.summary: Anti-war protesters demonstrated in Athens against the upcoming visit of U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio to Greece, gathering near the embassy.

stories.title: Husiler Aden Havalimanı’nı hedef aldı: Yolcular tahliye edildi

en.title: Houthis targeted Aden Airport: Passengers evacuated
en.summary: Iran-backed Houthi forces reportedly attacked Aden International Airport in southern Yemen using ballistic missiles and unmanned aircraft, prompting passenger evacuation.

en.title: "Erdoğan you are right in the middle of it"
en.summary: A political statement addresses Erdoğan regarding officials from his party who are appointed, elected, and accused of misappropriation.

stories.title: Derin Mermerci'nin Boğaz'daki yalısına vapur çarptı

en.title: Ferry crashed into Derin Mermerci's mansion on the Bosphorus
en.summary: A passenger ferry collided with a historic waterfront mansion in Vanikoy belonging to Derin Mermerci, causing damage to both the building and vessel.

en.title: 'Traffic's big sister' took her own life
en.summary: A police officer named Yasemin Bodur Karasu, who worked long-term at the Traffic Control Branch in Kütahya, died by suicide involving a firearm.

stories.title: AKP’li eski vekil Asım Aykan: Neşteri vur yoksa millet sandıkta vuracak

en.title: Former AKP deputy Asım Aykan: Strike with the scalpel or the people will strike at the ballot box
en.summary: Former Trabzon Mayor and Parliament member Asım Aykan, expressing criticism related to fund issues, called for decisive action from AKP leadership.

stories.title: Ankara'da uygulama noktasında polise ateş açıldı: 1 şehit

en.title: Shots fired at police checkpoint in Ankara: 1 killed
en.summary: Gunfire erupted at a police checkpoint in Ankara, resulting in the death of police officer Ahmet Türkoğlu.

stories.title: Son Dakika... 2026-KPSS lisans sınav sonuçları açıklandı

en.title: Breaking news... 2026-KPSS bachelor exam results announced
en.summary: The Public Personnel Selection Exam Board released results for the 2026-KPSS Bachelor General Aptitude, General Knowledge, and Field Knowledge tests.

stories.title: Son dakika... Ege'de peş peşe depremler! AFAD'dan açıklama geldi

en.title: Breaking news... Successive earthquakes in the Aegean! Statement from AFAD
en.summary: Two earthquakes with magnitudes of 4.1 and 4.2 occurred in the Aegean Sea during nighttime hours. The disaster management authority provided information about the epicenters of these seismic events.

stories.title: Derin Mermerci sosyal medya hesabından paylaştı: Üsküdar'da yolcu vapuru yalıya çarptı

en.title: Passenger ferry crashes into waterfront mansion in Üsküdar, shared on social media by Derin Mermerci
en.summary: A passenger ferry in Üsküdar collided with a businessman's waterfront mansion and a nearby boat. The incident was shared on social media with a caption referencing charity.

stories.title: Ferdi Zeyrek'in ölümüne ilişkin bilirkişi raporunda çarpıcı detaylar

en.title: Striking details in expert report regarding Ferdi Zeyrek's death
en.summary: An expert report investigating the death of Manisa Metropolitan Municipality Mayor Ferdi Zeyrek has been completed. Four individuals were found primarily responsible in the incident.

stories.title: Ferdi Zeyrek’in ölümüne ilişkin bilirkişi raporu çıktı… Rapor ihmaller zincirini gözler önüne serdi

en.title: Expert report on Ferdi Zeyrek's death released... Report reveals chain of negligence
en.summary: An expert report concluded that Manisa's mayor died from electrical contact in a pool machine room due to a chain of negligence by multiple parties across different organizations. The report found Zeyrek himself was not at fault.

stories.title: 7 EKİM 2026 ÇARŞAMBA YAYIN AKIŞI: Bu akşam hangi diziler var?

en.title: 7 OCTOBER 2026 WEDNESDAY BROADCAST SCHEDULE: What series are on tonight?
en.summary: Television viewers can find information about today's broadcast schedule across Turkish national channels. Various series and programs from networks including Kanal D, ATV, and Show TV will air this evening.

stories.title: 2026-KPSS lisans sonuçları açıklandı: Sonuçlar nasıl sorgulanıyor?

en.title: 2026-KPSS Bachelor Results Announced: How to Query Results?
en.summary: The examination board released results for the 2026-KPSS Bachelor General Aptitude-General Knowledge and Field Knowledge test. Candidates can access their results through the official system using their national ID numbers and candidate passwords.

stories.title: Petrolde düşüş sadece bir gün sürdü, Brent yeniden 101 doları aştı

en.title: Oil Decline Lasted Only One Day, Brent Surpassed 101 Dollars Again
en.summary: Brent crude oil fell below 100 dollars but quickly recovered above 101 dollars the next day. Supply concerns resurfaced due to an anticipated tropical system in the Gulf of Mexico and attacks along the Saudi Arabia-Yemen corridor.

en.title: EU Prepares New Sanctions Against Russia
en.summary: The European Union is preparing to significantly expand its sanctions list against Russia with one of its largest additions to date. A decision today covers approximately 1,650 new individuals and entities, with roughly 1,570 targets linked to military-industrial sectors and missile production.

stories.title: Fed tutanakları bu akşam: Faiz artışı beklentisi bir haftada çöktü

en.title: Fed Minutes Tonight: Interest Rate Hike Expectations Collapsed in a Week
en.summary: The Federal Reserve will release minutes from its September meeting this evening. Market expectations for an October rate increase fell from 51 percent to 20.5 percent within a week, with focus on what conditions Fed members seek for further increases.
